rows.ja: 提携・買収・ライセンス

relations.text: Impinjは、NXPとの和解契約に基づくライセンス収入の大きな割合を得ており、NXPを主要なエンドポイントIC競合と位置づけている
relations.text_en: Impinj derives a substantial share of its licensing revenue from NXP, its primary endpoint IC competitor, under a Settlement Agreement

source.label: Impinj 10-K
source.quote: We currently derive a substantial share of our licensing revenue from NXP, our primary endpoint IC competitor, based on our Settlement Agreement with them.

relations.text: NXPはImpinjに少額の現金を支払う和解契約を結び、係争中だった手続きはすべて取り下げられた
relations.text_en: NXP entered into a settlement agreement paying Impinj an immaterial cash consideration, with all previously pending litigation dismissed

source.label: NXP Semiconductors 10-K
source.quote: (“Impinj”) entered into a settlement agreement with the Company paying Impinj an immaterial cash consideration, resolving all outstanding litigation and other proceedings between the parties, with all previously pending litigation and administrative proceedings being dismissed.

relations.text: NXPはTSMCと、Systems on Silicon Manufacturing Company Pte.という合弁会社に参加している
relations.text_en: NXP participates in a joint venture with TSMC called Systems on Silicon Manufacturing Company Pte.

source.label: NXP Semiconductors 10-K
source.quote: For example, we currently participate in a joint venture with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (“TSMC”) called Systems on Silicon Manufacturing Company Pte.

relations.text: NXPはTSMC、Bosch、Infineonとの合弁会社ESMCで、将来の製造需要に対応する能力を作るとしている
relations.text_en: NXP has a joint venture with TSMC, Robert Bosch Gmbh and Infineon Technologies AG called ESMC to create capability for its future manufacturing requirements

source.label: NXP Semiconductors 10-K
source.quote: (“VSMC”), and a joint venture with TSMC, Robert Bosch Gmbh and Infineon Technologies AG called European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (“ESMC”) to create capability for our future manufacturing requirements.

relations.text: ASEは2007年8月6日付の持分譲渡契約で、NXPとの合弁会社ASENの60%を取得した
relations.text_en: ASE acquired 60% of ASEN, its joint venture with NXP Semiconductors, under an Equity Interests Transfer Agreement dated August 6, 2007

source.label: ASE Technology Holding 20-F
source.quote: Equity Interests Transfer Agreement dated August 6, 2007 by and among NXP B.V., NXP Semiconductors Suzhou Ltd. and J&R Holding Limited relating to our acquisition of 60% of ASEN, our joint venture with NXP Semiconductors (incorporated by

relations.text: MarvellとNXPの間に2019年5月29日付の資産売買契約がある
relations.text_en: Marvell lists an Asset Purchase Agreement with NXP dated May 29, 2019

source.label: Marvell 10-K
source.quote: 2.3 Asset Purchase Agreement between Marvell and NXP dated May 29, 2019
source.note: 契約名のみの記載です。

relations.text: NXPは2025年7月24日にSTMicroelectronics Internationalと、事業を最大9億5000万ドルの現金で売却する正式合意に至った
relations.text_en: On July 24, 2025, NXP reached a definitive agreement with STMicroelectronics International N.V. to sell a business for up to $950 million in cash

source.label: NXP Semiconductors 10-K
source.quote: On July 24, 2025, NXP reached a definitive agreement with STMicroelectronics International N.V., under which NXP will sell the business for an amount up to $ 950 million in cash, including $ 900 million at closing and up to an additional $ 50 million subject to the achievement of technical milestones.

relations.text: Avnetは2025年の売上高の23%、2024年は22%を占めた

source.quote: Avnet accounted for 23% of our revenue in 2025 and 22% in 2024.

source.quote: We also have a strong position with our distribution partners, including our five largest in alphabetical order, Arrow, Avnet, Nexty, WT Micro and World Peace.

relations.text: 最大10社のエンドカスタマーの1社としてAppleを挙げている

source.quote: Our 10 largest end customers, some of whom are supplied by distributors, in alphabetical order, are Apple, Aptiv, Aumovio, Bosch, Denso, Harman Auto, Hyundai, LGE Automotive, Samsung and Visteon.
